title: Listening cycles backend: ListeningCycle/CycleVerdict schema and the local cycle publish/pull runner
description:
See the epic apricitus-2101dd for the data design (candidates are fork Scores, stars are Ratings, new ListeningCycle + CycleVerdict only).
Schema: add ListeningCycle + CycleVerdict to web/amplify/data/resource.ts; npm run contract; contract:check green; apricity serve (local mode) serves them.
Runner: scripts/cycle.py publish|pull|list (analysis package). publish: create fork Score records (forkOf = incumbent, tagged candidate), upload audio, write the ListeningCycle; the blind key goes to renders/log.jsonl. pull: read Ratings + CycleVerdict, log them, close the cycle. Targets: the local library (local mode) and the cloud (DynamoDB rows + S3 via AWS credentials, the prune_aws.py pattern) with owner set so the signed-in user owns the records.
Verify: candidate scores don't enter the public tag leaderboards (tally Lambda). pytest round-trip against the local backend. A real Ave House cycle published locally, read through apricity serve GraphQL, a verdict written through GraphQL, pulled back.
